Can we use a petrol pressure washer inside the flooded shop to blast mud after water receded?

Do not run petrol equipment inside a shop, corridor, or partly enclosed space. It can create carbon monoxide, which can kill without warning. Use manual cleaning or equipment placed safely outdoors with exhaust away from doors and windows. Also avoid spraying contaminated mud onto food shelves, medicines, people, or electrical points.
